claim: Glattfelden railway station is situated in the municipality of Glattfelden.

passages.text: Railway station in Switzerland. Glattfelden railway station is a railway station in the Swiss canton of Zurich. The station takes its name from the nearby municipality of Glattfelden, although it is actually situated in the municipality of Bülach. It is located on the Winterthur to Koblenz line of Swiss Federal Railways, within fare zone 113 of the Zürcher Verkehrsverbund (ZVV).

Village in Hjelmeland Municipality, Norway. Årdal is a village in Hjelmeland Municipality in Rogaland county, Norway. The village is located at the eastern end of the Årdalsfjorden at the mouth of the river Storåna. The village sits about 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) southeast of the village of Fister and about 12 kilometres (7.5 mi) south of the village of Hjelmeland.
